newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar futures close at lows, on support.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar futures close at lows, on support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures finished down and at session lows and on nearby support, pressured by speculative selling and a dearth of buyers, traders said.
Activity was rangebound and volume thin at an estimated 7,596 lots.
Spot March contract ended down 0.09 cent at 10.66 cents a lb after trading from 10.74 to 10.66. The back months settled unchanged to 0.06 lower.
Support was seen at current levels and then at a gap in the charts between 10.50 and 10.48 for March delivery. Traders pegged resistance from 10.75.
Market sources said speculative shortcovering could lift prices in the near term, but bearish fundamentals could cap the move.
